title: Financial Controller - Latam
description:
Our Mission
At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:
Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life.
Our vision is a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we’re looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are.
Who We Are
We take our mission of protecting the digital way of life seriously. We are relentless in protecting our customers and we believe that the unique ideas of every member of our team contributes to our collective success. Our values were crowdsourced by employees and are brought to life through each of us everyday - from disruptive innovation and collaboration, to execution. From showing up for each other with integrity to creating an environment where we all feel included.
As a member of our team, you will be shaping the future of cybersecurity. We work fast, value ongoing learning, and we respect each employee as a unique individual. Knowing we all have different needs, our development and personal wellbeing programs are designed to give you choice in how you are supported. This includes our FLEXBenefits wellbeing spending account with over 1,000 eligible items selected by employees, our mental and financial health resources, and our personalized learning opportunities - just to name a few!
At Palo Alto Networks, we believe in the power of collaboration and value in-person interactions. This is why our employees generally work full time from our office with flexibility offered where needed. This setup fosters casual conversations, problem-solving, and trusted relationships. Our goal is to create an environment where we all win with precision.
Job Description
Your Career
Palo Alto Networks has an exciting opportunity for a LatAm Controller to join our Finance Team. We are looking for a financial professional interested in a senior level opportunity as a regional Controller to ensure accuracy and completeness of accounting and financial reporting for the Palo Alto Networks legal entities in the Latin American region and play a key role in re-engineering processes to drive improvement. This position has extensive interaction with cross-functional business partners at all levels, including senior management in multiple geographical locations.
A successful candidate will be proactive, confident and solution-oriented, have a broad set of work experiences within a Finance organization, and will provide a strong voice to represent Finance throughout the Controllership to arrive at solutions all cross-functional groups will find reasonable.
Your Impact
  • Identify actionable insights and drive cross-functional process improvements including, but not limited to, internal and external financial reporting, regulatory compliance, internal controls and system integration in the region
  • Lead the formulation of the Country Controlling strategy for the region to align with business needs and corporate strategy
  • Take ownership of facilitation and creation of accurate project plans with clearly defined milestones, deliverables and tasks
  • Perform monthly detailed reviews of the regional financial statements to ensure alignment with corporate reporting and local accounting GAAP reporting requirements
  • Perform month-end close for the regional entities to ensure accurate US GAAP and company policy compliant financial statements, including reviewing monthly transactions, account reconciliations, and balance sheet and income statements for reasonableness
  • Effectively provide guidance and support to GL resources in the Palo Alto Networks Center of Excellence to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of the regional month-end close process
  • Coordinate with IT, global and regional accounting functions, and regional third-party accounting service providers on regional system implementation projects
  • Establish effective partnerships with Palo Alto Networks Global Process Owners, Centers of Excellence and corporate and regional accounting teams to drive the incorporation of global process standards in the region
  • Establish and document all policies, process and procedures localization requirements for the region
  • Effectively manage third-party service providers in region to improve the quality, timeliness and efficiency of their services
  • Coordinate annual statutory audits for various entities in region
  • Review and approve non-routine transactions in the regional entities
  • Ensure controls and discipline are in place to achieve high employee satisfaction within the region
  • Drive cross-functional initiatives in region
  • Ensure local compliance with regional regulations, regulatory filings, and accounting rules (GAAP)
  • Effectively partner with regional and corporate FP&A and People teams to provide accounting insight and support on regional matters
  • Work with cross-functional teams on treasury and tax strategies to support compliance and the corporate goals for the region
Qualifications
Your Experience
  • At least 8-12 years of relevant experience in a medium to large size international reporting environment is required and working experience in high tech companies with prior Big 4 accounting firm experience is a plus.
  • Bachelor’s in accounting or finance – Contador or equivalent certification a plus
  • In-depth expertise, excellent working ability, and knowledge of local GAAP accounting principles, regulatory compliance and reporting requirements
  • Hands-on experience managing the accounting and financial reporting processes for international operations in the Latin American region
  • Experience with SAP or other large ERP systems
  • Proficient in US accounting standards, principles and pronouncements
  • Proven ability to work in fast-paced environments, meet challenging deadlines and priorities, deliver on multiple simultaneous projects and drive changes
  • Problem solver with strong critical thinking and project management skills
  • Demonstrated judgment in prioritizing work, identifying issues and recommending solutions, and managing multiple tasks simultaneously
  • Fluent in English, fluent in Spanish or Portuguese a plus
  • Highly collaborative with a leadership attitude to take initiative to solve problems
  • Highly proficient in Excel and Google Sheets
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships and collaborate effectively, including cross-functionally
Please submit your resume in English only so that it can be properly evaluated by the Hiring team. Resumes in other languages, including Portuguese and Spanish, will not be considered for the open role.
 Additional Information
The Team
You have a passion for numbers & integration, our organization has a passion for cybersecurity. You’re looking for a career with a more fulfilling mission. We have open positions to top talent seeking a financial challenge. Our accounting department deals with numbers daily, supporting infrastructure, dealing in automation, building solutions and providing accurate, insightful financial information to empower our business lines. The ideal candidate has exceptional skills in accounting and analytics and an innovative mindset to approach finance problems differently. Our innovation doesn’t stay in Research and Development. Within finance and accounting, we seek people who are looking to try new things, while solving business critical equations. If you’re seeking a financial challenge but with a world-wide impact – this is it.
Our Commitment
We’re problem solvers that take risks and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.
We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at
Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.
All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position.

title: Senior Consultant – Global Transaction Banking
description:
Join NFQ!


We are a global consulting firm specialized in business, technology, and operations, with over 2,000 professionals across national and international offices. At NFQ, we offer a different consulting model: Flexible | Scalable | Specialized | Client-Centric .


As part of our continuous growth, we are looking for an experienced Senior Consultant with strong expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) to join our team in São Paulo (Hybrid model).


If you are passionate about corporate banking solutions , trade finance , and cash management , and want to lead impactful transformation projects in the financial industry, this opportunity is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Lead gap analysis, requirements gathering, and validation to define practical solutions and perform comparative assessments with a strategic focus on Global Transaction Banking (GTB) .
  • Drive and support initiatives in:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Factoring/Receivables Finance, Supply Chain Finance/Confirming, Export & Agency Finance, Structured Trade).
  • Cash Management (cash pooling, sweeping, virtual accounts, liquidity dashboards).
  • Plan, oversee, and coordinate project deliverables within defined time and cost parameters .
  • Prepare and deliver project reporting to senior management through presentations and executive updates.
  • Coordinate workshops and meetings with internal and external stakeholders for strategic alignment and requirements validation.
  • Define and execute testing initiatives in collaboration with IT teams.
  • Ensure alignment and coordination between Business, IT, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders to meet client needs.
  • Support change management and successful adoption of new systems or processes.


Must-Have Qualifications

  • Knowledge of PIX (Brazilian instant payments): rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Understanding of Brazilian regulations (BACEN: PIX, TED, DOC) and international trade finance standards .
  • Proven experience participating in the implementation of PIX (Brazil’s instant payment system) , including setup, rules, reconciliation, and immediate settlement.
  • Minimum of 3 years of experience in financial consulting, institutional or corporate banking , or related sectors.
  • Hands-on expertise in Global Transaction Banking (GTB) with working knowledge in at least one of the following:
  • Trade Finance & Working Capital (Documentary Trade, Supply Chain Finance, Receivables Finance).
  • Cash Management (payments, liquidity, pooling, virtual accounts).
  • Proven skills in requirements gathering, senior-level reporting, IT liaison, and testing .
  • Familiarity with corporate banking platforms such as Finastra, Temenos, Oracle Flexcube, Kyriba, or similar.
  • Experience with digital and API-based GTB solutions .
  • Fluent English (written and spoken).
  • Spanish is a strong plus.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with ERP / Treasury Management Systems (TMS) such as SAP Treasury, Kyriba, Oracle Treasury, or Finastra.
  • Familiarity with process automation (RPA) and liquidity dashboards (Power BI, Tableau).
  • Experience in operational and liquidity risk management .
  • Exposure to cross-border payments, FX, and international trade finance projects .
  • Proficiency in agile methodologies (Scrum, Kanban), workshop facilitation, and requirements discovery.
  • Relevant certifications such as CPA-20, CTP, CFA ;
    graduate degrees (Master’s or specialization) in Finance, Economics, International Business, or Risk Management.


Preferred Education

  • Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Banking, Accounting, Engineering (Industrial, Systems, Production) — strong foundation in corporate finance, trade finance, and process optimization.
  • Advanced education (Master’s level or specialization) highly valued:
  • Master’s in Finance, Economics, or International Business.
  • MBA focused on strategic management and stakeholder engagement.
  • Postgraduate degrees in Banking, Treasury, or Risk Management.


What We Offer

  • Language classes to boost your global career.

  • VR - R$ 800,00

title: 2026 Global Management Trainee Program - Latam
description:
Hunter Douglas is the world’s leading manufacturer of window coverings and a major manufacturer of architectural products. We are a brand that you know and trust. With more than 100 years of innovation, we’ve defined our industry with proprietary products that deliver revolutionary style and functionality and can be found in millions of homes and commercial buildings globally.

We are searching for candidates that are driven, intelligent, creative, and entrepreneurial. By offering challenging and accelerated opportunities for growth, powered by a shared hunger for success, we create a space for your career to thrive. In return for your expertise, we are committed to providing competitive and robust total compensation and benefit packages to ensure you feel valued. Our dream is to become the fastest growing, most loved, window covering company in the world. What’s yours?

Position Overview

The Hunter Douglas Global Management Trainee Program (GMT) is hand-selected and sponsored by the Executive Leadership Team. This 10-month comprehensive Leadership Development program provides you with the tools and experiences to develop you into a future leader of our organization while providing a holistic view of the business. Throughout this program, you will immediately immerse yourself into the company, the culture, and the industry. You will join a class of other Trainees and gain a community of ambitious peers. You will learn from Hunter Douglas leaders and contribute directly to our purpose and our DREAM. You will gain insights from day one and do real work on different projects while delivering actual results.

Before the program commences, Trainees are paired with a Mentor to help acclimate and integrate you to our organization. Throughout the program, you can expect opportunities to connect and collaborate with our Executive Leadership Team, Global Leaders, Business Leaders, previous Trainees and current Trainees from other Zones.

What you'll do

  • Three weeks of onboarding - one week of local onboarding at your designated hub location and zone.
    • Global Induction at our HQ - providing an introduction to our company's strategy, culture, products, sales channels and problem-solving approaches.
  • Five months of Field Training in which you will rotate through key areas of our value chain including Sales, Supply, Logistics, Product, Customer Service, and will gain hands-on experience by actively participating in daily operations and project work during each rotation.
  • One week of Leadership and Methodology training to foster a unified system-thinking approach and prepare you for your first project.
  • A four-month individual project in which you will be able to deliver tangible and measurable results as an active team member by applying methodology skills and technical knowledge.
  • Capstone presentation of your project to Leadership, followed by feedback and final placement into a full-time role upon program completion - designed to support your continued leadership development and long-term career growth with Hunter Douglas.
  • First Position Placement can be in any of the following areas: Sales, Operations (Supply, Logistics, Procurement), Product, or Functional.

Below are examples of projects that previous Trainees' have worked on

  • Create a new implementation process for when Hunter Douglas introduces a new product.
  • Implement recommendations to optimize material usage and mitigate scrap rates at our plants.
  • Pricing Analysis for our e-commerce platforms.
  • Develop a communication strategy to enhance our customer installation journey.
  • Monetize our Market Funnel valuation by quantifying our conversion rates.

Qualifications:

  • To qualify, candidates must have an expected graduation date of December 2025
  • Have demonstrated leadership capabilities through various extracurricular activities including job experiences, internships, student clubs and organizations, and volunteer work.
  • Must be fully mobile and willing to be on-site at one of our major locations throughout the program. Be ready to tackle new challenges in diverse environments, including front line roles in the field, manufacturing plants, regional offices, among others.

Who you are

  • Hard-working and enjoys a high level of responsibility.
  • Hungry for success, yet humble to continuously learn.
  • You think like an owner and take accountability for your actions.
  • Problem-Solver who leads with agility and acts with a sense of urgency.

title: Analista Fiscal Jr
description:
Você conhece a Sany do Brasil?


Fundada em 1989 em Changsha, na China, o Grupo Sany dedica-se à produção de máquinas pesadas, tendo como principais produtos as máquinas para construção civil, pavimentação, escavação, reach stacker, guindastes, máquinas portuárias e de mineração. Há 20 anos, o Grupo Sany tem conquistado progresso e sucesso na sua jornada. Possui dez fábricas na China, uma na Índia, uma na Alemanha e uma nos Estados Unidos, além de aplicar políticas agressivas como a de dedicar 5% de seu faturamento anual em pesquisa e desenvolvimento de novas tecnologias.


Como parte da sua estratégia de crescimento, em 2012, a Sany adquiriu a empresa alemã Putzmeister. A união das áreas de negócios da Sany e da Putzmeister formou o maior líder mundial da área de equipamentos para concreto. Atualmente, a Sany emprega cerca de 40 mil colaboradores em mais de 150 países.


No Brasil, a trajetória do Grupo Sany iniciou em 2007, quando atuava como importador de equipamentos. O ano de 2011 marcou a consolidação do Grupo no país, com o anúncio de investimentos da ordem de US$ 200 milhões. Em janeiro do mesmo ano, a Sany inaugurou na cidade de São José dos Campos, interior de São Paulo, sua primeira unidade fabril para montagem de escavadeiras e guindastes sobre caminhão no regime de CKD (Completely Knock-Down), em uma área total de 30 mil m².


Em 2012 a Sany recebeu da Fundação Carlos Alberto Vanzolini a certificação de qualidade ISO 9001:2008, garantindo o rigoroso processo de qualidade e segurança da empresa.

Em 2013, visando uma nova etapa de crescimento, a Sany iniciou a montagem dos guindastes RT (rough terrain) e dos rolos compactadores na sua unidade fabril.


No final de 2017, inauguramos as nossas instalações na cidade de Jacareí/SP.


A Sany possui uma rede de distribuidores e filiais próprias pronta para oferecer seus produtos e excelentes serviços de pós-vendas em todas as regiões do país.


Como nosso Analista Fiscal, você irá:

  • Análise de documentos fiscais: NFe, CTe NFSe;

  • Conhecimento emobrigações acessórias: SPED ICMS/IPI, EFD Contribuições, DIRBI
  • Conhecimento em registro de notas fiscais de entrada;
  • Conhecimento sobre regras de carta de correção;
  • Experiência comsistema integrado, SAP ECC e Tax One será diferencial.

  • Conhecimento avançado em Microsoft Office (Work, PowerPoint e Excel);

title: Lead Technical Consultant
description:
Company Overview

At Synamedia, we’re a global team of 1,700+ trailblazers across 20 countries, revolutionizing how the world is entertained and informed. With a legacy of protecting our long-time customers, we’re laser-focused on driving growth and leading the charge as the industry shifts from Pay-TV to IP and streaming. We are the pioneers in next-gen media cloud services who power the viewing experiences of billions of people on Earth with our best-in-class live streaming, distribution, ad tech, cloud platforms, and more.

Our solutions, built over three decades and trusted by 1,000+ customers, fuel giants like Disney, NBA, The Olympics, Astro, Comcast, Tata Play, and many more.

Ready to grow with us and shape the future of media and entertainment solutions? Let’s do it together!


About the Job – Lead Technical Consultant


Key Responsibilities:

  • Ensuring a healthy platform delivering smooth services for all the customers.
  • Provide strong technical leadership to ensure continuous improvement across the team
  • Prime contributor for automation and scripting tasks.
  • Must have worked in a fast-paced, quick response/crisis handling team.
  • In-depth knowledge and experience of supporting complex projects.
  • Command and control during High Priority Events.
  • Responsible for contribution in refining Service Centre tools and processes.
  • Implement monitoring scripts to prevent repetitive issues.
  • Able to work independently or as part of a team towards complex issue resolutions.
  • Ability to collaborate with customer deployment teams.
  • Solid communicator, with excellent written and spoken Portuguese and English.
  • Must know ITIL framework (Incident, Change, Problem, configuration)
  • Independently/collectively troubleshoot issues reported by customer on ServiceNow ticketing tool.
  • Accurate analysis, tracking and reporting of any problems or issues found during investigation.
  • Contribute to the knowledge management in the department.
  • Collaboration with the support and deployment teams to resolve issues. Good with documentation and RCA preparation.
  • Development of training material, for education and knowledge sharing with other team members as appropriate.
  • A good understanding how to monitor and improve service quality.
  • Stay on top of customer reported issues, regularly communicate with customers.


Technical Skills:

  • Excellent in problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Excellent Linux Systems Administrator.
  • Good experience with at least one scripting language (bash, python, perl).
  • Experience in support and configuration of software applications on both Linux and Windows operating systems.
  • Knowledge of applications clusters for application redundancy desirable ,e.G., Red Hat Cluster.
  • Experience with operation and support of virtual machines using VMware (vSphere and vCenter) would be advantageous
  • Experience with a video delivery system, preferably in a support or integration role.
  • Solid with relational database (Oracle preferred) and non-relational database (Mongo preferred). Good understanding of networking, TCP/IP and UDP protocols
  • Good understanding of network transfer protocols HTTP, FTP.
  • Proven SQL scripting skills.
  • Strong in automation and process improvement.
  • Experience in digital video delivering systems with in-depth knowledge in at least one of the following technologies: Conditional Access, DRM, OTT, STB, Encryption, Decryption.
  • Knowledge of MPEG/DVB or other video delivery technologies.
  • Awareness of STB software and hardware.
  • Ability to understand data represented in XML or JSON.
  • Good to have knowledge of Media products.
  • Aware of multimedia concepts in Mpeg2, H.264, TS, OTT, IPTV, HD & SD resolutions, 4K TV, DRM, VOD, Live streaming, PPV, Adaptive Streaming
  • Team handling experience would be a Plus.



Qualifications, Experience and Personnal skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree/BCA/ B. Tech or equivalent.
  • Ideally 8 years of experience in a relevant support, integration, or deployment role.
  • Ability to work within a multi-tasking dynamic environment and cope with changing priorities
  • Quick learner
  • Proactive
  • Customer focused
  • Experience dealing with global customers.
  • Ability to work individually or as part of a team
  • Strong communicator at management and technical levels
  • Self-motivated and self-sufficient


Growth Opportunities

When welcoming new talent into the team, we are always looking for opportunities to bring in new ideas, those who ask challenging questions and have the curiosity to learn. These qualities are important to us as we nurture a culture of innovation, seize more opportunities to partner with our customers and make a difference as we transform the future of video. To further support your growth and that of our talent pool, Synamedia offers an exhaustive library of skill enhancement resources from AWS, SkillSoft and other partners to help you upskill while on the job. Be it data analytics that piques your brain or content creation, there’s something for every kind of mind.


Benefits and Perks

  • Flexible working arrangements.
  • Competitive pay hikes and bonus packages.
  • Skill enhancement and growth opportunities.
  • Equal opportunity employment.
  • Health and wellbeing programmes.
  • Collaborative work with a truly global team.


A Culture of Belonging

Synamedia is committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive and equal opportunity community - a place where we can all be ourselves and succeed. Our values connect us, and we love to win together. We work with a bias to action, have a bold approach and encourage being deeply curious to grow and evolve, as a team.

In our aim to foster a people-friendly environment, we offer a range of family friendly, inclusive employment policies, flexible working arrangements, engagement activities and services to support all our colleagues across our 20 office locations. Synamedia regularly organises community events that promote cohesion and diversity among colleagues. We are proud of our mental health wellbeing initiatives, our Pride month awareness campaign, our cancer awareness programme and much more.


More information

If this role sparks your interest or any questions, or if you require any accommodations to be made to help you through your application, please reach out to our recruitment team, who would be happy to help.

title: Pessoa Coordenadora De Ambiência- Arquitetura
description:
ALLOS é uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Somos referência em excelência e inovação, com a qualidade e confiança que faz parte da nossa história.

A nova marca surgiu pronta para o futuro, a partir da fusão entre a Aliansce Sonae e a brMalls , em 2023. Mas, essa trajetória começou bem antes.


Tudo começou com a Aliansce, que inaugurou o primeiro shopping da região Nordeste e o segundo do Brasil em 1975. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. Em 2006, surge a brMalls resultando em um portfólio de 30 ativos presentes nas cinco regiões do país.


E assim, em 2023, a ALLOS surge com o encontro de duas potências nacionais do segmento, unindo forças para se tornar a mais inovadora plataforma de entretenimento, lifestyle, serviços e compras.

Nossa história continua e estamos prontos para criar momentos que transformam e impactam a vida das pessoas, gerando conexões e oportunidades.


Atividades:


  • Coordenar a equipe de SAC, recepção e Ambiência, visando a melhor experiência do cliente e a excelência em atendimento, tratando diretamente situações críticas de atendimento ao cliente e que necessitem de intervenção;
  • Coordenar a equipe do fraldário, proporcionando atendimento e ambientes agradáveis com excelência para aos clientes.
  • Acompanhar e analisar indicadores, bem como as pesquisas de NPS
  • Desenvolver e implementar políticas, procedimentos e diretrizes de qualidade em todas as áreas sob sua responsabilidade, incluindo, atendimento, limpeza, paisagismo, higiene alimentar, dedetização, gestão de resíduos e reciclagem, obras em lojas e reformas internas;
  • Gerenciar as atividades de equipes terceirizadas que prestam serviços essenciais para o shopping, como limpeza, HSA, asseio, paisagismo, gestão de resíduos, reciclagem, aromatização.
  • Garantir que os restaurantes e as operações de alimentação do shopping sigam rigorosamente os padrões de higiene alimentar da Anvisa, com o controle e gestão da consultoria terceira, que realiza um ciclo de inspeções e ações corretivas, notificando as lojas inadequadas quando necessário.
  • Manter e aperfeiçoar o padrão de reciclagem e boas práticas sustentáveis que o Shopping realiza, com o intuito de ampliar e estender o programa, a fim de desenvolver e implantar melhores práticas para minimizar o impacto ambiental do shopping e atingir e mata da companhia.
  • Coordenar projetos de reforma de ambientes internos do Shopping e supervisionar obras contratadas pela ALLOS. Gerenciar as Obras e reformas de lojas no shopping, garantindo que as obras sejam executadas de acordo com os padrões de qualidade estabelecidos e ocorram dentro do prazo programado.
  • Gerenciar e orientar equipe orgânica, garantindo que todos cumpram suas responsabilidades de forma eficaz.
  • Preparar relatórios de desempenho de qualidade e comunicar regularmente os resultados e problemas ao Gerente de Operações.
  • Garantir que o Shopping esteja em conformidade com todas as regulamentações e normas relevantes, incluindo as relacionadas à acessibilidade, segurança e higiene. Atentar aos prazos de vencimento de licenças e documentos.

  • Power BI será um diferencial;

No iFood, acreditamos na força da diversidade para gerar #Inovação e alcançar #Resultados incríveis. Por isso, valorizamos candidatos independentemente de deficiência, gênero, orientação sexual, raça/etnia, idade, origem, constituição familiar ou estética. Temos grupos compostos por foodlovers voluntários, onde falamos sobre Raça, Gênero, LGBTQI+ e PcD. Queremos ser a empresa onde as pessoas escolham se desenvolver e realizar seus sonhos. #AllTogether.


Conheça nossas iniciativas | Institucional iFood


Você Tem Fome de Quê?

Temos fome de inovação e resultados. Sempre buscamos fazer o nosso melhor, pensando "fora da caixa" e agindo com agilidade e responsabilidade. Valorizamos a diversidade, o conhecimento e o compartilhamento em um ambiente dinâmico e versátil. O ingrediente especial da nossa receita? As pessoas. Vem fazer parte disso!

Essa lógica também se aplica à nossa cultura: temos um DNA inovador que instiga todo o nosso time a se reinventar constantemente. Responsabilidades:

  • Atuação orientada a padrões reutilizáveis, governança, segurança e ROI, colaborando com times de negócio e tecnologia para acelerar resultados mensuráveis.
  • Monitorar e otimizar latência, custo, acurácia e experiência do usuário, assegurando SLAs/SLOs e melhoria contínua.

  • Apoiar a governança com relatórios técnicos sobre comportamento, desempenho, riscos e oportunidades de evolução.
  • Liderar implantações em ambientes produtivos, com estratégias de rollout/rollback, observabilidade e pós-mortem quando necessário.


Requisitos

  • Experiência prática com LangGraph (orquestração) e LangFuse (tracing/evals).
  • Python avançado (código limpo, testes automatizados, tipagem) e SQL sólido.
  • Experiência com RAG/vetorização (pipelines de embedding, avaliação) e orquestração/pipelines (desenho, deploy, observabilidade).


Diferenciais

  • GCP hands-on: Vertex AI (incluindo Agents Engine, ADK, Vector Search), BigQuery, Cloud Run/Functions, Apigee, Composer (Airflow) e Vertex Workflows.
  • PydanticAI, MCP, A2A para interoperabilidade multiagente e controle de políticas/guardrails.
  • Governança e segurança: PII-redaction, mascaramento, DLP, OAuth/OIDC e políticas de acesso.
  • Medição de impacto: KPIs de qualidade, custo e latência dos agentes.
  • FinOps: right-sizing e controle de custo por chamada/tokens.


Soft skills

  • Comunicação técnica e executiva clara, traduzindo complexidade em valor de negócio.
  • Pensamento sistêmico, visão ponta a ponta do ciclo de valor e foco em reuso.
  • Ownership e responsabilidade direta por resultados em produção.
  • Influência e negociação de prioridades com stakeholders de negócio e tecnologia.

O modelo de trabalho dessa posição é híbrido 3x2 (três dias presenciais e 2 de home office) na Vila Olímpia em São Paulo

️ Vale refeição no valor de R$1.050,21 ao mês;

title: Solutions Architect (Openshift/Podman)
description:
Please submit your resume in English - we can only consider applications submitted in this language.


Company Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We’re a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. Our critical communications, video security and command center technologies support public safety agencies and enterprises alike, enabling the coordination that’s critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals and safer businesses. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future.


Department Overview

At Motorola Solutions, we help people be their best in the moments that matter. We help firefighters see around buildings and police officers see around street corners. Our work is very meaningful, impactful, and cutting edge and we invite you to explore it. We are the Best!


Motorola Solutions is a world leader in the field of professional mobile communications systems with an impressive heritage of technological innovations and a global base of installed systems. The group's main business is the implementation of mission critical digital mobile communication systems for Government & Public Safety Communications customers.


Join to the team providing Solution Architecture for Unified Communications customers for EMEA/APAC/LATAM regions.


Job Description

Join a dynamic and innovative team at the forefront of mission-critical communications. We are responsible for delivering advanced Push-to-Talk (PTT) solutions over broadband with seamless interoperability to Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems. As a Network and Systems Engineer, you will play a crucial role in building and maintaining the core infrastructure that powers our services.

The ideal candidate is a skilled and proactive individual with a strong background in IP networking, a deep understanding of cloud-native technologies, and an interest in cybersecurity. In addition to core engineering duties, you will take ownership of hardware ordering and security vulnerability management, making this a pivotal role within the team.


Key Responsibilities

  • Design, configure, and maintain robust IP network infrastructure, including switches and firewalls.
  • Manage and support virtualization and containerized environments, with a focus on cloud-native platforms like OpenShift and Podman.
  • Lead the hardware ordering process for the team, utilizing the Motorola CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote) system.
  • Monitor and manage security-related issues, including vulnerability management for customer-facing solutions.
  • Ensure the reliable and secure interoperability between broadband PTT solutions and Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to resolve technical challenges and contribute to solution architecture.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor degree in Engineering
  • In-depth knowledge of IP networking principles and practical experience with switches and firewalls.
  • Demonstrated experience with virtualization technologies and container platforms.
  • Hands-on experience with cloud-native technologies, such as OpenShift or Podman.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and a proactive approach to system maintenance and security.


Preferred Skills & Qualifications (A Plus)

Certifications:

  • CompTIA Network+, CompTIA A+, CompTIA Security+
  • CCNA or CCNP
  • Juniper, FortiGate, or Extreme Networks certifications


Engineering Expertise:

  • Experience with datacenter engineering, including server connectivity (Ethernet vs. fiber) and adapters.
  • A strong interest or background in cybersecurity.


Relevant Experience:

  • Previous experience with Push-to-Talk (PTT) over broadband or Land Mobile Radio (LMR) systems.
  • Familiarity with hardware ordering processes and CPQ systems.

title: Senior Talent Acquisition Partner - Tech
description:
Who We Are

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours.
We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

Job Description

Please note this is a 6-month fixed-term contract role.


The Opportunity

Are you passionate about recruiting top talent for Tech and Product roles? Join our global business at Cint as a Talent Acquisition Partner, where you will support our R&D (Tech and Product) teams. Our Talent Acquisition (TA) function is critical to our success, as it enables us to attract and hire the right talent that drives our business forward. In this role, you will proactively manage the recruitment process, working closely with business leaders to attract and hire the best candidates for our commercial and finance functions.


The Team

You will be part of an established global TA team comprising both technical and non-technical recruiters. We pride ourselves on our collaborative culture, where we support one another, share information, and celebrate successes. We continuously evaluate and improve our processes to ensure we remain at the forefront of talent acquisition.

Join us at Cint and be a part of a dynamic team that plays a vital role in our global success. If you are ready to take on the challenge and drive the recruitment of top technical talent, apply now!


What You Will Do

  • Full-Cycle Recruitment: Lead and execute the entire recruitment process for roles within our Tech and Product functions.
  • Consultative Partnership: Work closely with hiring managers, People Partners, and Finance Partners to share industry trends, compensation insights, and competitor updates.
  • Educate Hiring Managers: Provide guidance on best practices, recruitment strategies, and process improvements to enhance their hiring practices.
  • End-to-End Process Management: Manage all aspects of the hiring process, including writing job advertisements, posting ads, sourcing and screening candidates, arranging interviews, and extending job offers.
  • ATS Management: Maintain and update our Applicant Tracking System (ATS) – SmartRecruiters.
  • Support DEI: Promote and support Cint’s commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI) through continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Continuous Improvement: Engage in projects with the TA team to implement process changes that enhance our ability to identify and attract talent.
  • Data-Driven Storytelling: Analyze your performance metrics to identify strengths and areas for development, and share these insights with the team.
Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • Experience: Proven experience in a talent acquisition/recruiting role, managing end-to-end recruitment for commercial vacancies in Brazil/North America.
  • Commercial & Finance Insight: Understanding the importance of the Tech/Engineering and Product functions within a global business.
  • ATS Proficiency: Ability to maintain and manage an accurate ATS.
  • Data-Driven Approach: Ability to analyze performance metrics and use data to drive recruitment strategies.
  • Collaborative Mindset: Strong team player who can collaborate effectively to address challenges and develop solutions.
  • Proactive Sourcing: Willingness to source candidates proactively to find the right expertise.

Bonus Points If You Have

  • ATS Experience: Previous experience using the Smart Recruiters ATS.
Additional Information


Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen;
    every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. ( />

title: Principal Software Engineer - Data Solutions & Measurement
description:
Cint is a global software leader in technology-enabled digital insights and research technology. The Cint platform automates the insights-gathering process so that companies can gain access to insights faster with unparalleled scale. Cint has one of the world’s largest consumer networks for digital survey-based research, made up of over 239 million engaged respondents across more than 130 countries. Over 4,600 insights-driven companies use Cint to accelerate how they gather consumer insights and supercharge business growth.

Job Description

The Team

The Cint Technology team is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our international Data Solutions & Measurement team. This position is for a software engineer who likes challenges. Our business has been doubling in the last few years and so our systems need to scale to accommodate this growth.

What You Will Do

Our ideal candidate considers themselves among the highly technical and likes to push the limits of their knowledge and experience every day. In this role, you will lead the design, implementation, scaling, and maintenance of the code that powers our production systems. You will work autonomously, providing technical direction and ensuring timely and high-quality delivery across multiple projects. You will proactively communicate and collaborate with cross-functional teams, including Product and Data Science, to drive strategic initiatives. With significant freedom to innovate, you will play a pivotal role in world-class research, shaping the next generation of Cint products and mentoring less experienced engineers.

Qualifications

What We Are Looking For

  • 10+ years of hands-on professional backend software development experience, with a significant portion in a leadership or principal role.

  • Degree in Computer Science or related field.

  • Proficient programming skills in Python or Java and comfortable maintaining code in both languages, with a strong emphasis on architectural design and code quality.

  • Deep familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, advanced testing frameworks, and deployment strategies.

  • Extensive experience with complex API integration, design, and best practices, including defining API standards.

  • Expertise in dealing with system complexity, distributed systems, and large-scale architectural challenges.

  • Exceptional sense of ownership, accountability, and technical leadership.

  • Outstanding problem-solving, analytical, and strategic thinking skills.

  • Consistently questions the status quo and brings innovative, impactful solutions to engineering and product needs, driving significant technical advancements.

  • Strong ability to influence architecture and technical decisions across multiple teams, ensuring robust, scalable, and cost-efficient solutions that align with business objectives.

  • Enjoys working as part of a team, actively mentoring and guiding other engineers, and providing constructive feedback to foster growth.

  • Comfortable with making critical decisions based on comprehensive data analysis and industry best practices.

  • Outstanding communication skills to guide and facilitate complex cross-functional collaboration and present technical strategies to diverse audiences.

  • Extensive background in data analytics tools such as Spark, Hive, Databricks, or similar, with experience in designing and optimizing data pipelines.

  • Deep familiarity with observability strategies, including advanced monitoring, logging, and tracing.

  • Extensive experience with AWS, Microservices, Docker, Kubernetes, and advanced SQL, including database design and performance tuning.

Additional Information

Our Values

Collaboration is our superpower

  • We uncover rich perspectives across the world
  • Success happens together
  • We deliver across borders.

Innovation is in our blood

  • We’re pioneers in our industry
  • Our curiosity is insatiable
  • We bring the best ideas to life.

We do what we say

  • We’re accountable for our work and actions
  • Excellence comes as standard
  • We’re open, honest and kind, always.

We are caring

  • We learn from each other’s experiences
  • Stop and listen;
    every opinion matters
  • We embrace diversity, equity and inclusion.


More About Cint

We’re proud to be recognised in Newsweek’s 2025 Global Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces®, reflecting our commitment to a culture of trust, respect, and employee growth.

In June 2021, Cint acquired Berlin-based GapFish – the world’s largest ISO certified online panel community in the DACH region – and in January 2022, completed the acquisition of US-based Lucid – a programmatic research technology platform that provides access to first-party survey data in over 110 countries.

Cint Group AB (publ), listed on Nasdaq Stockholm, this growth has made Cint a strong global platform with teams across its many global offices, including Stockholm, London, New York, New Orleans, Singapore, Tokyo and Sydney. ( />

description:

Esta posição tem como foco principal a avaliação e monitoramento dos controles de segurança e riscos tecnológicos, assegurando conformidade regulatória, mitigação de vulnerabilidades e proteção da integridade, confidencialidade e disponibilidade dos sistemas e dados.

  • Realizar uma análise crítica dos processos de negócio e de TI para identificar oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Avaliar e testar as medidas de segurança.
  • Interagir com áreas de TI, Compliance, Riscos e operações para garantir alinhamento das iniciativas de segurança.
  • Elaboração de relatórios: Documentar os achados da auditoria, gerando relatórios detalhados com recomendações.
  • Realizar follow-up das recomendações.


O que buscamos em você:

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia da Computação, Segurança da Informação, Sistemas de Informação ou área correlata.
  • Experiência em auditoria de TI / Segurança da Informação, preferencialmente em Instituições Financeiras.
  • Experiência com auditoria de redes, análise de vulnerabilidades, resposta a incidentes, testes de intrusão, controle de identidade e acesso.
  • Experiência em auditorias de conformidade. (ISO 27001, NIST, FFIEC).

Conhecimentos técnicos:

  • Protocolos de rede, criptografia, firewall, IDS/IPS, VPN, redes seguras.
  • Ferramentas de análise de vulnerabilidades (ex. Nessus, Qualys, etc.).
  • Ferramentas SIEM.
  • Frameworks de segurança (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001).
  • Conhecimento em arquitetura segura, proteção de APIs.
  • Noções de TI geral: BD´s, VM´s, sistemas operacionais, Cloud.


Habilidades e idiomas:

  • Raciocínio analítico, visão de riscos, boa comunicação para relatar resultados.
  • Capacidade de influenciar áreas de TI para adoção de melhorias.
  • Autonomia, iniciativa e capacidade de gerenciar prioridades
  • Inglês e Espanhol intermediários.

description:
#Nosso jeito de fazer história:

Como analista de negócios o papel será atender os clientes internos ou externos da Neoway sempre buscando entender os fluxos de tecnologia e negócios dos produtos e planos de negócios das áreas atendidas, fomentando evolução/inovação/melhoria contínua onde aplicável. Entendimento e mapeamento de negócios, análise de negócios, exploração de dados, desenvolvimento de KPIs, discussão técnica referente às tecnologias utilizadas (Neoway e cliente) e ambientes analíticos para desenvolvimento de solução e maior.

    promovendo também novastecnologias e metodologias que possam ser aplicadas ao portfólio de produtos da empresa, avaliando a viabilidade de sua implementação.

title: Coordenador De Tesouraria - Holding
description:
Acreditamos que um time diverso é mais capaz de gerar valor e ser resiliente, por isso nossas vagas estão abertas para todas as pessoas. Vem ser Iguatemi! A Iguatemi Empresa de Shopping Centers S.A. é uma das maiores empresas full service no setor de shopping centers do Brasil. Suas atividades englobam a concepção, o planejamento, o desenvolvimento e a administração de shopping centers regionais, outlets e complexos imobiliários de uso misto com torres comerciais. A Iguatemi detém participação em 14 shopping centers, 2 Premium Outlets e 3 torres comerciais. As ações da Iguatemi estão listadas no Novo Mercado da B3 (IGTI11) e fazem parte do índice Ibovespa. Nossa missão é criar experiências únicas e memoráveis a todos os nossos clientes.


⛳ MISSÃO DO CARGO

Responsável por consolidar os caixas das operações trazendo para a visão holding, assim como apresentar o caixa orçado para o ano seguinte, gerir o caixa e explicar suas variações versus budget. Também é responsável pelas aplicações financeiras da companhia (via fundos exclusivos ou Tesouraria), negociar e emitir as dívidas (após análise de mercado para escolha da melhor opção), assim como acompanhar e gerir os covenants. Fechar operações de câmbio para o GMC assim como emitir suas dívidas. Gerir a equipe, visando uma linha sucessória para todos, inclusive para sua própria cadeira. Participar ativamente de qualquer operação estruturada que a companhia venha a fazer.


RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPAIS - O quê e como ?

  • Gerir as atividades diárias da Tesouraria Holding, como pagamentos, fechamentos de câmbio, aplicações e resgates, coordenando a equipe e reportando à Gerência Corporativa e Vice-Presidência;
  • Coordenar a gestão diária do Fluxo de Caixa das empresas da Holding, garantindo a disponibilidade dos recursos onde são necessários na organização e produzindo os relatórios correspondentes;
  • Promover o desenvolvimento e a motivação da equipe, concedendo oportunidades de crescimento e aprendizado, dando feedback estruturado, revendo a distribuição de atividades e as necessidades de aprimoramento;
  • Garantir a correta definição e dimensionamento dos cargos e que os mesmos estejam ocupados pelas pessoas certas;
  • Assegurar a rentabilidade das aplicações financeiras do Grupo, analisando o desempenho das carteiras de aplicações e dos fundos gestores, elaborando relatórios de performance e revisando a política de investimentos;
  • Preparar relatório mensal para apresentação pelo Gerente Financeiro e participar na reunião do Comitê Financeiro, contemplando o desempenho das aplicações financeiras, a evolução do caixa consolidado e as projeções revisadas para o ano. Além disso também é responsável pela análise de desempenho dos gestores para possíveis trocas ao longo do tempo;
  • Participar ativamente das negociações e implementações de operações financeiras não triviais ou operações financeiras estruturadas;
  • Participar ativamente da negociação e emissão de novas captações, mútuos e financiamentos. Controlar o estoque de dívidas existentes, apurando saldos devedores, custos, vencimentos e pagamentos, obrigações não financeiras, covenants e produzindo os relatórios e análises solicitados;
  • Preparar e enviar as informações solicitadas por clientes internos (ex., auditorias) e externos (ex., agências de rating), apoiando o Gerente Financeiro no relacionamento bancário e de agências de crédito. Além de ser responsável pelas comprovações de lastros das dívidas que pedem isso;
  • Responsável pela elaboração do Orçamento em formato "caixa" a partir do Orçamento da Contabilidade, sendo figura principal para apresentação dos números relacionados à holding. Assim como é responsável pelos inputs de dívida e caixa ao longo deste mesmo processo de Orçamento;
  • Responsável pela aprovação de pagamentos a fornecedores até o limite de R$ 5.000,00 por título e auxiliar o Gerente no controle de custos do Centro de Custo da área.


OBSERVAÇÕES

Superior Completo em Administração, Ciências Contábeis, Engenharia, Economia, Estatística ou Matemática.

title: Public Relations Account Coordinator
description:
Esenca is a strategic communications agency based in Brazil. We work with companies across Latin America to design and execute PR, content, and brand experience strategies. Our clients range from startups to large companies in tech, crypto, and finance. We move fast, we work close to the business, and we focus on building strong, relevant brands.


We’re looking for a Public Relations Coordinator to join our team. You’ll be responsible for planning, coordinating, and, when necessary, executing strategies for media and stakeholder engagement, strengthening the brand’s reputation with the press and other relevant audiences, working across different client accounts, and supporting the day-to-day of the PR manager.


Main Responsibilities

- Team Coordination

Work collaboratively with external communications teams, guiding and contributing to the effective execution of daily tasks such as planning, press release distribution, pitch suggestions, article production, meeting notes and agendas, reports, and other PR-related routines.

- Strategic PR Planning

Develop and implement institutional communication plans focused on public relations initiatives.

- Press and Media Management

Build and maintain relationships with journalists, influencers, columnists, and media outlets.

Review, guide, and, when needed, write and distribute press releases, official statements, and institutional articles.

Guide and coordinate interviews, media briefings, press conferences, and media training for spokespeople.

- Crisis Management

Act proactively and reactively in reputation crisis situations, developing contingency plans and public response strategies.

- Institutional Relations

Guide and promote engagement efforts with partners, trade associations, government bodies, and other stakeholders.

Represent the company at events, talks, trade fairs, and strategic forums.

- Events and Brand Activations

Support or lead corporate events, inaugurations, awards, roadshows, and institutional actions involving brand image.

- Reputation Monitoring

Track and analyze media and social media mentions of the company, producing brand image performance reports.

Use clipping and media monitoring tools to report on PR campaign results.


Requirements

- Degree in Public Relations, Journalism, or Social Communication.

- Proven prior experience in leadership or coordination roles in PR.

- Established relationships with the press.

- Strong organizational and project management skills.

- Good communication and ability to work with different teams and clients.

- Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

- Strong skills in crisis management and institutional positioning.

- Comfortable with fast-paced environments and multitasking.

- Knowledge of PR tools (e.G., I’Max, PressManager, Google Alerts, etc.).

- Fluent in Portuguese and English.


Compensations & Benefits

- Employment type: CLT Hybrid (remote with 2x/week in-office in Osasco/SP).

- Multibenefits allowance card.

- Life insurance.


Hiring Process

- Application review and screening based on requirements.

- First interview (in person and in English).

- Skills assessment.

- Final interview with the CEO and hiring.

title: Senior Specialist Operations
description:
ABOUT SHEIN

SHEIN is a global online fashion and lifestyle retailer, offering SHEIN branded apparel and products from global network of vendors, all at affordable prices. Headquartered in Singapore, SHEIN remains committed to making the beauty of fashion accessible to all, promoting its industry-leading, on demand production methodology, for a smarter, future-ready industry. Founded in 2012, SHEIN has more than 16,000 employees operating from offices around the world, and continues to expand operations globally. Join SHEIN and be the future!


Job Description

We are looking for a Senior Specialist Operations to join our Supply Chain team, with strong analytical and project management skills, solid experience in operational planning, exception handling, and continuous improvement. This professional will be responsible for ensuring that workforce, equipment, and infrastructure are strategically dimensioned and continuously optimized to meet operational volumes with quality, agility, and cost efficiency. The role also involves leading data-driven initiatives, conducting time and motion studies, and driving process improvements through accurate analysis and collaboration with multiple departments.


Responsibilities

The Senior Specialist Operations will develop and monitor short-, medium-, and long-term capacity and workforce planning for in-house operations, analyze and allocate resources based on demand and performance, and ensure that operational KPIs such as efficiency, SLA, absenteeism, and UPH are continuously tracked and improved. This person will lead exception handling routines, identify root causes, and implement preventive actions to stabilize processes.

The role includes managing and executing continuous improvement projects focused on productivity, efficiency, and cost reduction, performing time and motion analysis to establish standard times, eliminate waste, and improve process flow. The professional will generate and interpret analytical reports and dashboards using BI tools such as Tableau or Power BI, ensuring data accuracy and visibility for decision-making.

Collaboration with global and local teams is essential to align planning strategies, forecast volumes, and validate supplier capacity. The position also requires preparation of performance reports and the ability to present insights and recommendations to senior management.


Requirements

Proven experience in Operational Planning, Exception Handling, and Process Improvement within logistics or e-commerce operations. Strong knowledge of S&OP and S&OE processes, fluent English for daily interaction with international stakeholders, advanced analytical and communication skills, and solid experience with Power BI, Tableau, or other data analysis tools.


Nice to Have

Experience with WMS systems and warehouse operations, advanced Excel and Google Sheets skills, knowledge of Lean or Six Sigma methodologies, experience managing projects using structured frameworks and KPIs, familiarity with process mapping and automation tools, and prior experience conducting time and motion studies or labor standardization initiatives.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Comprador - Projetos
description:
Sobre a Empresa

A Joyson Safety Systems é uma empresa global especializada em sistemas de segurança automotiva, com foco em componentes críticos como Airbags, Cintos de Segurança, Volantes, tecnologias integradas de segurança e peças plásticas.

O profissional também será responsável por intermediar as cotações de projetos junto à equipe de Vendas/ED, assegurando a precisão dos custos e a viabilidade do cronograma.


1. Gestão de Cronograma e Prazos (Foco Central)

  • Acompanhamento Crítico de Prazos: Monitorar ativamente o cronograma de compras de cada projeto, garantindo o One-time sourcing e Confirmações de capacidade de carry over partes junto ao time de Commodity.
  • PO de Amostras e Ferramental: Fará o processamento, emissão e acompanhamento dos POs.
  • Relatório de Risco: Identificar, documentar e comunicar imediatamente quaisquer desvios ou riscos no cronograma de aquisição ao Gerente de Projetos e ao Gerente de Compras, propondo planos de ação corretivos.

2. Facilitação e Intermediação Interna

  • Ponto Focal Engenharia-Compras: Atuar como o elo de comunicação primário entre a Engenharia (Gestão de Projetos) e o Departamento de Compras, traduzindo as necessidades técnicas em requisitos de compra claros e vice-versa.
  • Otimização de Processos: Colaborar com a Engenharia e Compras para otimizar o fluxo de trabalho de aquisição de projetos, reduzindo o tempo de ciclo e eliminando gargalos.
  • Reuniões de Alinhamento: Participar regularmente das reuniões de cronograma e kick-off de projetos para garantir que a estratégia de aquisição esteja integrada desde as fases iniciais.

3. Cotação de Novos Projetos (Interface com Vendas)

  • Intermediação de Cotações: Receber as especificações preliminares de novos projetos da equipe de Vendas e coordenar o processo interno de cotação junto ao time de Compras.
  • Análise de Custos: Assegurar que as cotações de fornecedores considerem as especificações técnicas e os prazos exigidos, auxiliando na formação de preços de venda competitivos e realistas.

4. Processo de Compras e Análise Técnica

  • Processo de Compras: Aplicar o conhecimento sólido em todo o ciclo de compras (RFP/RFQ, análise de propostas, negociação, colocação de pedidos, gestão de contratos).
  • Análise de Desenhos: Realizar a leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos e especificações da Engenharia para garantir que o pedido de compra e as negociações com fornecedores reflitam fielmente os requisitos técnicos do projeto.
  • Qualificação de Fornecedores: Apoiar o desenvolvimento e a qualificação de fornecedores estratégicos para projetos, em conjunto com o time de Sourcing e Qualidade.

Requisitos Essenciais

  • Formação: Superior completo em Engenharia, Administração de Empresas, Comércio Exterior ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência: Sólida experiência como Comprador, preferencialmente em compras de projetos (Project Procurement ) e/ou Gestão de Projetos PM.
  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Conhecimento robusto do processo de compras (Sourcing e Procurement ), e capacidade de leitura e interpretação de desenhos técnicos/especificações.
  • Idiomas: Inglês fluente (Obrigatório) para comunicação efetiva com fornecedores internacionais, leitura de documentação técnica e gestão de contratos globai s.


Se você se identificou com os requisitos dessa vaga, faça sua inscrição e boa sorte!

A key responsibility is maintaining quality and security by design, implementing best practices that uphold governance, security, and performance standards.


This role offers the opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies such as data, machine learning, artificial intelligence, and cloud platforms to develop intuitive, self-healing, and optimized database solutions. You will collaborate across global teams, working across full technology stacks to solve enterprise-scale challenges, drive technology adoption, and influence change within a dynamic environment.

  • Design and build distributed database platforms to enhance the customer experience.

  • Leverage AI to enhance systems and optimize processes as a Self-Service Product.
  • Shape the architecture and platform, including decisions around low-level configurations.
  • Ensure quality and security are integral to all processes and solutions.
  • Collaborate across teams to solve complex problems and implement cutting-edge technologies.


Experience & Qualifications

  • Proficiency in backend languages such as Python, C++, or Java, with experience developing RESTful APIs.
  • Familiarity with DBMS technologies, including SQLServer, Oracle, and PostgreSQL.
  • Deep understanding of cloud infrastructure, with experience in containers and microservices.
  • Proven experience leveraging security and lean development principles such as CI/CD pipelines for scalability and continuous delivery.

title: Project Manager Sênior
description:
Project Manager Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.


Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital , ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.


Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.


Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos . Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

Você será responsável por conduzir a execução de projetos estratégicos, garantindo que cada etapa — do planejamento ao deploy — aconteça dentro dos prazos, orçamentos e expectativas estabelecidas. Seu papel envolve coordenar equipes multidisciplinares, monitorar riscos, assegurar uma comunicação eficaz entre todas as partes envolvidas e garantir o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da companhia.


Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Acompanhar o progresso de cada fase do projeto (refinamento, planejamento, desenvolvimento, testes, homologação, deploy e operação assistida), garantindo que as entregas ocorram dentro do cronograma e com qualidade;
  • Monitorar e reportar o andamento das atividades, promovendo visibilidade e alinhamento constante com stakeholders;
  • Validar o planejamento de sprints e prioridades, garantindo aderência aos objetivos estratégicos;
  • Gerir recursos humanos e financeiros, assegurando a eficiência na alocação e uso dos investimentos;
  • Produzir materiais e relatórios de status para comitês executivos e áreas envolvidas;
  • Atuar na mitigação de riscos e na remoção de impedimentos que possam impactar o sucesso do projeto.


Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Experiência sólida em gestão de projetos corporativos complexos, preferencialmente no setor financeiro, de energia ou utilities;
  • Capacidade de coordenação entre múltiplas áreas, mantendo alinhamento entre tecnologia, negócio e stakeholders;
  • Domínio em monitoramento de prazos, gestão de riscos e orçamentação de projetos;
  • Habilidade de comunicação clara, objetiva e executiva;
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis e entendimento de processos de desenvolvimento de software (refinamento, testes, deploy e operação assistida).


Você pode se destacar se:

  • Tiver background financeiro ou experiência direta com gestão orçamentária e controle de custos;
  • Já tiver atuadoem projetos de transformação digital ou inovação;
  • Possuir certificações como PMP, PMI-ACP, CSM ou afins;
  • Demonstrar habilidade para traduzir necessidades estratégicas em planos de execução práticos;
  • Tiver facilidade em construir relações de confiança e colaboração entre times técnicos e executivos.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Rethinkers?

Básico que a gente ama

  • Cartão Caju para usar como quiser nos benefícios de alimentação e home office
  • Day-off no aniversário
  • Kit de onboarding com todas as ferramentas essenciais e mimos exclusivos para Rethinkers

Saúde e bem-estar

  • Auxílio bem-estar mensal
  • Convênio médico Bradesco (100% custeado pela Rethink, com cobertura nacional)
  • Assistência odontológica
  • Saúde mental com a plataforma Conexa Saúde
  • Wellhub para cuidar do corpo em movimento
  • On Happy para planejar suas viagens à lazer
  • Escritórios em Belo Horizonte e Ipatinga prontos para te receber

Carreira e desenvolvimento

  • Plataforma interna com cursos de hard e soft skills
  • Oportunidades reais de crescimento em um ambiente que valoriza o aprendizado contínuo

Como funciona o nosso processo seletivo?

  1. Inscrição
  2. Você começa sua jornada cadastrando seu perfil por aqui.
  3. Bate-papo com People
  4. Uma conversa leve para conhecermos você, sua história e seus objetivos — e te apresentarmos nossa cultura.
  5. Entrevista técnica com liderança
  6. Hora de mergulhar nas suas habilidades e experiências.
  7. Feedback final
  8. Independente do resultado, você receberá um retorno e os próximos passos serão alinhados com transparência.

Curtiu a oportunidade?

Então, vem repensar o futuro com a gente! ✨

Inglês fluente - será um diferencial para a posição


Resumo das responsabilidades do cargo:

Responsável por planejar e executar auditorias internas com atuação independente e de caráter técnico em projetos, obras, ativos industriais e processos de manutenção, assegurando a conformidade com normas regulatórias (NRs), normas técnicas de engenharia (ABNT, NBR, ISO), políticas corporativas e estratégias corporativas da CMOC, com objetivo de identificar riscos técnicos, falhas de projeto, desvios de execução e oportunidades de melhoria, contribuindo para a integridade, segurança e eficiência dos investimentos e operações da companhia.


Principais atividades:


Auditar projetos de CAPEX desde a concepção até a entrega, memoriais descritivos, cálculos estruturais, dimensionamentos, especificações de materiais e conformidade com normas técnicas (ABNT, ISO, NBR) e objetivos estratégicos da CMOC.

Elaborar pareceres, laudos e relatórios de auditoria, atestando a integridade dos dados, viabilidade, segurança e conformidade dos projetos auditados.

Auditar as justificativas técnicas de aditivos e mudanças de escopo, avaliando impacto em cronogramas, custos, qualidade e requisitos normativos.

Realizar auditoria técnica em campo, através de inspeções em obras, instalações e equipamentos industriais, verificando integridade estrutural, integridade dos reportes, condições operacionais e atendimento às normas regulatórias.

Auditar os registros técnicos de manutenção, ensaios não destrutivos, calibrações e inspeções periódicas, emitindo relatórios conclusivos sobre a confiabilidade dos ativos.

Realizar auditorias com objetivo de identificar riscos de falhas de projeto, acidentes, sobrecarga de equipamentos, não conformidades técnicas e potenciais impactos em segurança operacional.

Analisar as medições e entregas de obras e serviços de engenharia, verificando se os quantitativos, materiais e execução estão em conformidade com os projetos e normas.

Assegurar que projetos e operações estejam em conformidade com regulamentos nacionais (ex.: normas do MTE e CREA) e padrões internacionais aplicáveis à engenharia, através de pareceres técnicos de auditorias.

Produzir relatórios formais que consolidem achados técnicos e recomendações, assinados com ART (Anotação de Responsabilidade Técnica) quando aplicável.

Monitorar a implementação das recomendações de auditoria que envolvam alterações de projeto, reparos estruturais, adequações de equipamentos e melhorias técnicas.

Fornecer orientação técnica para a otimização de processos e mitigação de riscos, com objetivo de apoiar a equipe responsável pela gestão de obras, manutenção e operação industrial.



Outros requisitos necessários:

Metodologias de Gestão de Riscos, Controles Internos, Auditoria, Governança, Compliance (leis anti corrupção), Gestão de projetos (PMBOK, FEL, EPC/EPCM).

Controle orçamentário de CAPEX (budget, forecast, execução).

Contratos de engenharia, suprimentos e serviços.

Normas de auditoria interna (IPPF – IIA) e boas práticas de governança.

title: Analista Gis Sênior
description:
Vaga de atuação presencial no Cliente, localizado em Goiânia/GO.


Descrição da vaga

O profissional deverá suportar tecnicamente a equipe técnica do cliente, executando as atividades relacionadas a configuração, manutenção e melhor uso da plataforma ArcGIS, apresentadas a seguir:

- prontas para uso (Survey123, Dashboard, etc.);

- Mentoring e acompanhamento dos usuários da plataforma ArcGIS;

- Explicação sobre a utilização de extensões;

- Publicação e gestão dos serviços de mapas no ArcGIS Enterprise ou ArcGIS Online;

- Publicação de geoprocessing no ArcGIS Enterprise;


Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Prestar apoio no planejamento executivo dos projetos na aquisição, tratamento e gerenciamento de dados geoespaciais e alfanuméricos, realizando o levantamento de informações técnicas e analisando os insumos necessários com base em aspectos qualitativos e quantitativos;
  • Utilizar a edição de dados em geodatabase e criar modelos simples de geoprocessamento, criar, editar e explorar dados geográficos no ArcGIS Pro, criar layout simples de mapas e compartilhar mapas;

  • Utilizar ferramentas e funções do ArcGIS para criar fluxos de trabalho de SIG eficientes;
  • Realizar e aplicar modelagem de um geodatabase utilizando versionamento e elementos de rede e modelos complexos de geoprocessamento;
  • Aplicar a plataforma ArcGIS para realizar análise espaciais e ser capaz de automatizar processos;
  • Criar e aplicarelementos cartográficos dinâmicos e criar layout de mapas complexos;
  • Aplicar as funcionalidades do ArcGIS e ter habilidades avançadas para aplicar as ferramentas na visualização, criação, gerenciamento e análise de dados geográficos;
  • Aplicar o uso de geotecnologia nas diversas áreas de negócios verticais de atuação da Imagem;
  • Propor a escalade trabalho adequada para a solução de diferentes problemas geográficos;
